label: rare late-copy reset unit (last 1-2 copy steps, input p/k/j/t/1)
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.03% of steps) and weak. Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on the last or second-to-last output step (to_go 0-1, ~94% of mass), mostly for L=6-9 at recall_idx 5-6, and never in the original or delimiter phases. Input token is usually p, 1, k, j or t; the strongest examples also have prev_tok 3 (e.g. ...3 [p]). This context covers ~76% of activations / ~80% of mass, but the neuron fires on under 1% of the steps that match it, and adding prev_tok or out_tok conditions does not get F1 above ~0.12. Which matching steps fire seems to depend on finer sequence-specific state that I could not capture. Magnitude is highest when prev_tok is 3 and the input is p/k/1; I did not find a clean magnitude rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=p (+3.81), phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+3.80), prev_tok=3 (+3.56), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+3.45), phase=2 & in_tok=j (+2.71), recall_idx=6 (+2.66). Lower it: orig5=- (-1.53), to_go=3 (-1.35), phase=0 (-1.28), recall_idx=-1 (-1.28).
